extra_sample.name: mdpf_get_aggregate_aua
extra_sample.note: made first, smaller than the 743469 reply the CRO measured; kept as a sample, not counted

method: each reply requested ALONE from this seat through the gateway tool (the harness saved the oversized result to a local file, not read into context); the service cgroup's memory.current sampled every 0.5 s over an 80 s SSM command started just before each call; the cgroup memory.peak read at the end
reading: service memory rose by about 22 MB over the first (287791-character) sample and was flat or rose about 1 MB over the 743469- and 585084-character replies: replies of this size do not move the service's memory toward MemoryHigh (5600 MB); the 2026-10-19 hang cause is NOT established by this test
